thread:
alex chen: heads-up — opened a small postmortem addendum PR for INC-2026-14, mainly docs clarifications + a known-issues/workaround section. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8422

maria gonzalez: thanks — can you summarize the user-facing change here? product wants a one-line blurb for the release notes.

alex chen: sure. added: "If you saw request timeouts during the outage, retry with the same conversation; we preserved KV cache for 1h — see workarounds." also added the statuspage link and the incident timeline.

sarah kim: quick question — CI preview is failing for the example SDK snippet, looks like the python code block indent got eaten. i'm leaving an inline comment.

jen park: i can fix the snippet. do we want an explicit migration note for customers on dedicated who run older runtime (<v1.8)?

alex chen: yes, please — short note: customers on Dedicated v1.7 should pin model to non-streaming variant during rollout or upgrade to runtime v1.8. added a TODO comment where to insert.

ci-bot: PR 8422 — checks: docs-preview: failed (timeout), lint: passed, link-check: passed. retry available.

maria gonzalez: we need at least two reviewers for merge — tagging @sarah and @jen. can we merge this today? product prefers before morning stand (10:00 PT).

sarah kim: i'll review now. if jen pushes the snippet fix i'll re-check and approve.

jen park: pushed a tiny change to the python example. fixed the fenced block and added a one-line comment for dedicated users. snippet now:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate(model="open-rl-1", prompt="Summarize the outage")
print(resp.text)
```

alex chen: nice. also added the statuspage link (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-14) and a short workaround list: retry pattern, temporary rate-limits, and KV cache note.

ci-bot: retrying docs-preview for PR 8422...

ci-bot: docs-preview: success — deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-8422--redwood-docs.netlify.app/incidents/2026-14-addendum

maria gonzalez: approved from product side — the release notes blurb looks good. tagging release-engineering to cherry-pick to stable branch if we merge.

sarah kim: approved. small nit in wording left as suggestion but not blocking.

alex chen: thanks everyone. request: add label `postmortem-addendum` and `urgent-docs` before merge. also please coordinate with release-eng for a cherry-pick to v1.12-stable after merge.

jen park: labels added. i'll ping release-eng.

statusbot: note — incident INC-2026-14 has been moved from investigating -> resolved on status page.

alex chen: merging now after CI green. will follow up once cherry-pick is merged.

ci-bot: PR 8422 merged — commit 9af3b2c.

alex chen: done — thanks all :thumbsup:
